text:
Developing a mobile app is an exciting but complex process. A key first decision is whether to choose native or cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, offering top performance and seamless integration with the device, but they require separate codebases. Cross-platform tools like React Native or Flutter let you write one codebase for both, saving time and money, though performance can occasionally dip.

Regardless of the approach, responsive design is crucial—your interface must adapt smoothly to different screen sizes and orientations. Once your app is polished, you must distribute it through official app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play. These platforms have strict review processes, so testing for performance and stability is essential before launch, as a slow or buggy app will quickly lose users.
